notes: kb/Work PB284: PROSE-PARAGRAPH row. §9.1.16 paragraph 2: for AUTOMATIC single-record locking the runtime system sets and releases locks; for AUTOMATIC multiple-record locking it sets them and the application releases them by an explicit UNLOCK. Read: ReadSetsRecordLock sets the lock on every READ under AUTOMATIC, ReleasePriorRecordLocks releases the previous lock on the next I-O statement only under single-record locking (it returns early under Multiple), and UNLOCK releases the connector's locks (GR-12.4.5.9.4-4/-6/-7, GR-14.9.47.4-1, all CONFORMS). || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB284): record locking and the sharing/locking I-O statuses are decided at 2002 for the sibling rows GR-9.1.15-1..3, GR-9.1.13.8-1 and GR-9.1.13.9-1 (kb/Work PB3173), and this paragraph states the same facility.
